prompt:
Research the official rate limits of the public GitHub REST API for unauthenticated and authenticated requests. Cite the GitHub documentation page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official GitHub REST API documentation on rate limits, here are the limits for unauthenticated and authenticated requests.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "You can make unauthenticated requests if you are only fetching public data. Unauthenticated requests are associated with the originating IP address, and are limited to 60 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Unauthenticated GitHub REST API requests are rate-limited to 60 requests per hour per originating IP address.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "The primary rate limit for authenticated users is 5,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Authenticated GitHub REST API requests (using a personal access token) are rate-limited to 5,000 requests per hour per user.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "For Enterprise Cloud organizations, the limit is 15,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: Authenticated requests from users belonging to GitHub Enterprise Cloud organizations have a higher primary rate limit of 15,000 requests per hour.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api | QUOTE: "When using GITHUB_TOKEN, the rate limit is 1,000 requests per hour per repository." | CLAIM: Requests authenticated with the GITHUB_TOKEN in GitHub Actions workflows are limited to 1,000 requests per hour per repository.

Note: GitHub also imposes secondary rate limits (to prevent abuse) that apply on top of these primary limits, but the numbers above represent the documented primary rate limits for each authentication category.
